home.heroTitle: IT support, software and cloud services for Canadian businesses
home.heroText: One team for your systems, websites and applications. Work with us on a monthly plan, a fixed-price project, or by the hour.
home.heroNote: Clients across Canada · Reply within one business day

faqs.a: A set number of hours each month for any of our services, plus monitoring, updates, backups and a monthly report. Unused hours roll over once.

faqs.q: Can I hire you for one project?
faqs.a: Yes. Pick a fixed-price package or ask for a quote. Larger projects start with a deposit and are billed at milestones.
Yes, with clients in every province. We work remotely and cover Atlantic to Pacific business hours.

faqs.q: How do payments and taxes work?
faqs.a: Prices are in Canadian dollars. Pay by card through Stripe or by EFT on invoice. GST/HST or QST is added where it applies.

Up to 3 websites, stores or apps (WordPress, Magento, Odoo, custom)

Unlimited websites, stores and apps under management
Security reviews and audit evidence (SOC 2, PIPEDA)
Monthly executive report and roadmap session

services.name: Managed IT & Tech Support
services.short: Help desk, device and account management, monitoring and security for your team.
services.headline: Managed IT support for small and mid-sized businesses
services.intro: Your team should not lose an afternoon to a locked account, a failing laptop or a printer that vanished from the network. We run your help desk, manage users and devices, watch your systems and keep everything patched, so problems are solved quickly and stop coming back.
services.startingAt: Included in every subscription plan, or prepaid hours from $120/hour
outcomes: Help desk by email, chat and phone during Canadian business hours, with after-hours cover on higher plans
Onboarding and offboarding done the same day, with access removed when people leave
Laptops and phones enrolled, encrypted and patched automatically
Daily backups you have actually tested restoring
A monthly report: tickets, response times, risks found and what we fixed

services.name: Custom Software Development
services.short: Web apps, portals, integrations and internal tools built around how you work.
services.headline: Custom web applications, portals and integrations
services.intro: Spreadsheets and copy-paste between systems work until they don’t. We design and build the web apps, portals and integrations that remove that manual work: clean code, automated tests and documentation your next developer will thank you for.
services.startingAt: Discovery from $2,900; builds by fixed quote or a Growth/Scale plan
outcomes: A clickable prototype within the first two weeks, so you see it before you pay for all of it
Working software every two weeks, deployed to a test environment you can use
Automated tests and CI/CD from day one
Source code, documentation and accounts that belong to you

services.name: QA & Software Testing
services.short: Manual and automated testing for web, mobile and APIs, built into your release process.
services.headline: QA and software testing for web, mobile and APIs
services.intro: Bugs found by customers cost far more than bugs found in testing. We test your website, app or API before every release, automate the tests that matter most and run them on every change, so you can ship with confidence.
services.startingAt: QA audit and test plan from $1,900; ongoing testing through a monthly plan
outcomes: Clear test plans and a regression checklist for every release
Automated tests running in your CI/CD pipeline on every change
Bugs reported with steps, screenshots and severity, ready to fix
Accessibility and performance checked before launch

services.name: DevOps & Cloud Engineering
services.short: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and cost control on AWS, Azure and GCP.
services.headline: DevOps and cloud engineering on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
services.intro: Manual deployments, surprise outages and a cloud bill nobody can explain are signs the platform has outgrown how it is run. We automate builds and releases, put everything in code, add proper monitoring and cut waste, with Canadian regions wherever your data needs to stay in the country.
services.startingAt: DevOps & cloud audit $2,900; ongoing work from the Growth plan
outcomes: One-click (or automatic) deployments with instant rollback
Infrastructure defined in code and reviewed like application code
Dashboards and alerts that tell you about problems before customers do
A cloud cost review with savings ranked by effort and impact

services.name: AWS Cloud Services
services.short: EC2 servers, SES email, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront and more, set up and managed.
services.headline: AWS set-up and management, from EC2 to SES
services.intro: We design, set up and run your AWS account properly: secure networking, right-sized servers, managed databases, reliable email sending and backups, in Canadian regions where your data needs to stay in Canada.
services.startingAt: EC2 server set-up $1,900; Amazon SES set-up $690; ongoing care from the Essentials plan
outcomes: A secure AWS account structure with MFA, least-privilege IAM and audit logging
Servers and databases sized for your workload, with automatic backups
Email from your apps delivered through Amazon SES with full authentication
Monitoring, alerts and a monthly cost review

services.name: Ecommerce Development
services.short: Shopify, WooCommerce and Magento stores that load fast and convert.
services.headline: Ecommerce development for Canadian retailers
services.intro: Selling online in Canada means getting provincial sales tax right, shipping with Canada Post, Purolator or UPS, accepting Interac and cards, and often selling in French as well as English. We build and improve stores that handle all of it, and connect them to the inventory and accounting systems behind them.
services.startingAt: Store launch from $9,500; ongoing growth through a monthly plan
outcomes: Pages that load in under 2 seconds on mobile
Correct GST, HST, QST and PST by province, ready for your accountant
Live shipping rates and labels from Canadian carriers
Orders, stock and customers synced with your ERP or accounting software

services.name: Fintech Development
services.short: Payments, lending, wallets and banking integrations built securely.
services.headline: Software development for fintech and financial services
services.intro: In fintech, the product is only as good as the trust behind it. We build payment flows, onboarding and lending platforms, ledgers and dashboards with the controls regulators and partners expect: strong authentication, complete audit trails, encryption and clear separation of duties.
services.startingAt: Discovery from $2,900; builds by fixed quote or a Scale plan
outcomes: Secure-by-design architecture reviewed against OWASP ASVS
Double-entry ledgers that reconcile to the cent
KYC/AML onboarding flows ready for your compliance team
Evidence packs for bank partners, auditors and SOC 2

services.name: ERP Implementation & Integration
services.short: Inventory, accounting, purchasing and manufacturing in one system.
services.headline: ERP selection, implementation and integration
services.intro: When inventory lives in one spreadsheet, orders in another and accounting in a third, nobody trusts the numbers. We help you choose the right ERP, implement it in phases, migrate your data and connect it to your store and your accountant, so everyone works from the same truth.
services.startingAt: ERP readiness assessment $3,500; Odoo starter implementation from $14,900
outcomes: Real-time stock across warehouses and sales channels
Purchase orders, receiving and landed costs handled in one flow
Month-end close in days instead of weeks
Staff trained, with written procedures for every key process

services.name: Odoo Development & Implementation
services.short: Odoo set-up, custom modules, migrations and support.
services.headline: Odoo implementation, development and support
services.intro: Odoo can run sales, inventory, manufacturing, accounting, HR and your website from one platform at a fraction of the cost of traditional ERPs. We implement it properly: the Canadian localisation, the right apps for your processes and custom modules only where the standard ones don’t fit.
services.startingAt: Odoo starter implementation from $14,900; support from the Essentials plan
outcomes: Canadian chart of accounts and GST/HST/QST/PST set up and tested
Only the apps you need, configured around your real processes
Custom modules written to Odoo standards, so upgrades stay possible
Clean upgrade path to new Odoo versions

services.name: Magento (Adobe Commerce) Development
services.short: Magento builds, upgrades, performance and B2B commerce.
services.headline: Magento and Adobe Commerce development and support
services.intro: Magento is powerful for large catalogues and B2B selling, but only when it is kept patched, upgraded and tuned. We take care of the platform (security patches, upgrades, extensions and performance) and build the custom features your buyers need.
services.startingAt: Magento health audit $1,900; ongoing support from the Growth plan
outcomes: Security patches applied within days of release
Upgrades to the latest supported Magento / Adobe Commerce version
Faster pages through caching, image and database tuning
An honest view on whether to stay on Magento or move

services.name: WordPress Development & Care
services.short: Fast, secure WordPress sites, WooCommerce stores and monthly care.
services.headline: WordPress development, hosting and maintenance
services.intro: Most WordPress problems come from too many plugins, no updates and no backups. We build lean, custom sites your team can edit easily, then keep them updated, backed up, monitored and fast, so your website keeps working while you get on with business.
services.startingAt: Site launch from $4,900; care from the Essentials plan
outcomes: Green Core Web Vitals and fast mobile pages
Weekly updates, daily backups and uptime monitoring
Accessible to WCAG 2.1 AA, which helps with Ontario’s AODA
Built-in SEO foundations: schema, sitemaps and clean URLs

services.name: Mobile App Development
services.short: iOS and Android apps with React Native, Flutter or native code.
services.headline: iOS and Android app development
services.intro: A good app is more than screens: it needs a reliable backend, push notifications, analytics, store listings and regular updates for new OS versions. We take apps from idea to App Store and Google Play, and keep them healthy afterwards.
services.startingAt: App discovery from $2,900; MVPs by fixed quote
outcomes: One codebase for iOS and Android where it makes sense, native where it matters
Test builds on your phone every sprint
Store listings, screenshots and review submissions handled for you
Crash reporting and analytics from launch day

services.name: Business Email, SMTP & Cloud Services
services.short: Professional email, deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) and transactional SMTP.
services.headline: Business email, SMTP and deliverability
services.intro: If your invoices land in spam or your app’s password-reset emails never arrive, you are losing money and trust. We set up professional email for your organisation and reliable SMTP for your websites and apps, with the authentication that inbox providers now require.
outcomes: Professional addresses on your own domain for every team member
SPF, DKIM and DMARC aligned, meeting Google and Microsoft sender requirements
Transactional email for your apps with delivery tracking
Mailbox migrations with no lost mail

booking.pageText: Choose a time for a 30-minute video call with one of our consultants. We will discuss your goals and how we can help, at no cost.
booking.confirmationText: Thank you. Your consultation is booked. We will email you a video-call link before the meeting.
